structuredContent.body:
## Why this change is needed

The previous head's equal-input oracle shortcut skipped the second SQLite spool. Equal inputs could therefore succeed under a scratch capacity that rejected the original two-input store. It also added an unversioned per-table JSON field. Those compatibility findings are preserved in the review history.

## What this head changes

- Restore sequential A then B spooling and independent sorted cursors; remove the shortcut and its public witness field.
- Add a regression that first proves A fits with empty B, then requires the original SQLite full error for the same A with equal nonempty B under the same bound. Check the exact original nine-field table JSON contract.
- Retain batching, RowProjection, resource budgets, existing error-order and malformed-input controls, and the inherited cold/wide protocol engineering.
- Integrate #196's exact installer hook ownership, malformed-config/no-op preservation, first-create archive pointer protection and sparse unchanged scan actions. Its unchanged historical source review is retained.

## Reviewed source

- Product P: `44c3fa6d8d69c6e51c1c3eb717cbfd23dc80a1ec`
- Independent review R: `1776a4678704fd6d2ddfb805f4681ba0f840d0c0`
- Bound head G: `1434317f54beee5fb78731dbe6df8a16511dbe9e`
- Head tree: `9fc44fc5a7c1387acbbbceae7f7ed36da39c4a20`
- Complete inventory: 1096 product inputs, 78 baseline differences, 146 validation inputs.
- [Independent source review](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/1776a4678704fd6d2ddfb805f4681ba0f840d0c0/artifacts/checkpoints/p8-oracle-compatibility-integration-bfcc-20261009/independent-source-review.json)

The P2 review is by a non-author of the compatibility patch. A separate non-author review checked the actual R's two added review files and G's two binding changes, all registry maps, four verifier pins and unchanged verifier/CI algorithms.

## Validation and remaining gates

This remains **Draft pending actual current-head CI**. Source and binding reviews passed; the new Rust regressions, formatting, original v15 verifier and full CI have not yet run on this head. Earlier green CI belongs to its original checkout and does not substitute for these checks. The former shortcut's performance claim is withdrawn by removing the shortcut; no new speedup is claimed.

The original cold study `044c008c… / 37954851017 / attempt 1` and both registered scale studies keep their own immutable sources, populations, budgets and historical failures. They are not execution on this new head and are not pooled or relabeled. TODO status is unchanged: 163 done / 29 remaining.

## Scope limits

Existing-target archive replacement races and fixed-name installer gate/MCP ownership remain the previously documented limits. This PR does not grant release, live-provider, heldout-quality or full-scale acceptance. Revert product and matching source binding together if rollback is needed, preserving the review and original experiment records.

The previous head's equal-input oracle shortcut skipped the second SQLite spool. Equal inputs could therefore succeed under a scratch capacity that rejected the original two-input store. It also added an unversioned per-table JSON field. Those compatibility findings are preserved in the review history.

## What this head changes

- Restore sequential A then B spooling and independent sorted cursors; remove the shortcut and its public witness field.
- Add a regression that first proves A fits with empty B, then requires the original SQLite full error for the same A with equal nonempty B under the same bound. Check the exact original nine-field table JSON contract.
- Retain batching, RowProjection, resource budgets, existing error-order and malformed-input controls, and the inherited cold/wide protocol engineering.
- Integrate #196's exact installer hook ownership, malformed-config/no-op preservation, first-create archive pointer protection and sparse unchanged scan actions. Its unchanged historical source review is retained.

## Reviewed source

- Product P: `44c3fa6d8d69c6e51c1c3eb717cbfd23dc80a1ec`
- Independent review R: `1776a4678704fd6d2ddfb805f4681ba0f840d0c0`
- Bound head G: `1434317f54beee5fb78731dbe6df8a16511dbe9e`
- Head tree: `9fc44fc5a7c1387acbbbceae7f7ed36da39c4a20`
- Complete inventory: 1096 product inputs, 78 baseline differences, 146 validation inputs.
- [Independent source review](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/1776a4678704fd6d2ddfb805f4681ba0f840d0c0/artifacts/checkpoints/p8-oracle-compatibility-integration-bfcc-20261009/independent-source-review.json)

The P2 review is by a non-author of the compatibility patch. A separate non-author review checked the actual R's two added review files and G's two binding changes, all registry maps, four verifier pins and unchanged verifier/CI algorithms.

## Validation and remaining gates

This remains **Draft pending actual current-head CI**. Source and binding reviews passed; the new Rust regressions, formatting, original v15 verifier and full CI have not yet run on this head. Earlier green CI belongs to its original checkout and does not substitute for these checks. The former shortcut's performance claim is withdrawn by removing the shortcut; no new speedup is claimed.

The original cold study `044c008c… / 37954851017 / attempt 1` and both registered scale studies keep their own immutable sources, populations, budgets and historical failures. They are not execution on this new head and are not pooled or relabeled. TODO status is unchanged: 163 done / 29 remaining.

## Scope limits

Existing-target archive replacement races and fixed-name installer gate/MCP ownership remain the previously documented limits. This PR does not grant release, live-provider, heldout-quality or full-scale acceptance.
